title: Header nav link hover
question: Desktop header nav links currently fade opacity + lift 2px. Pick one coherent hover (no underlines).

options.label: Brass tint + lift
options.thesis: Ink softens to golden brass (#a67c42) at full opacity with the existing 2px atelier lift.
options.case: Matches DESIGN motion grammar and the one-accent rule without underlines.
options.risk: Brass on every link hover — keep transitions brief.

options.label: Parchment wash
options.thesis: Soft beige-2 pill behind the label; text stays ink (or slight brass on solid header).
options.case: Quiet atelier chrome; less accent usage.
options.risk: Can feel button-like next to the Request CTA.

options.label: Brass color only
options.thesis: Color shifts to brand brass; no translate — opacity settles to 1.
options.case: Cleanest feedback; drops the DESIGN.md 2px lift.
options.risk: Slightly flatter than the motion system intends.
